definition: The function $f(x) = \frac{1}{x}$, for $x \ne 0$, which sends each input to its reciprocal; its graph has the axes as asymptotes.
A function $f$ is self-inverse if $f^{-1}(x) = f(x)$, so applying it twice gives back the input: $(f \circ f)(x) = x$.
A function written as one polynomial divided by another, such as $f(x) = \frac{2x + 3}{x - 1}$.
